description: Authoritative end-to-end runtime call paths across core operational lifecycles.

pipeline_stages.name: Input Validation & Normalization
pipeline_stages.description: Validates schema types, ensures amounts are finite and non-negative, and applies ISO defaults.

pipeline_stages.name: Tenant Resolution & Access Control
pipeline_stages.description: Extracts tenant from JWT/header/API-key and blocks cross-tenant access with HTTP 403.

pipeline_stages.name: Online Feature State Retrieval
pipeline_stages.description: Fetches last committed customer history, chargeback rate, and rolling velocity snapshot from Redis/in-memory store. Ingestion scheduled asynchronously via BackgroundTasks.

pipeline_stages.name: Model Input Preprocessing & Padding
pipeline_stages.description: Converts transaction dictionary to PyTorch tensor; dynamically pads or truncates to model input dimension.

pipeline_stages.name: Active Neural Network Inference
pipeline_stages.description: Evaluates champion model on CPU/CUDA with torch.no_grad(). Optional shadow evaluation against challenger model via _load_challenger_model.

pipeline_stages.name: Property Graph Context Enrichment
pipeline_stages.activation_condition: Entity exists in property graph / streaming graph active window
pipeline_stages.description: Extracts entity node degree, prior alert flags, and 1-hop neighbor risk attributes.

pipeline_stages.name: Composite Risk Scoring Engine
pipeline_stages.description: Synthesizes ML prediction with FATF country risk, merchant category risk, velocity, and chargebacks into a [0, 1000] composite score.

pipeline_stages.name: Dynamic Policy Rule Evaluation
pipeline_stages.activation_condition: Active dynamic rules configured in database
pipeline_stages.description: Applies AST-validated conditional rules to allow, review, or block transactions.

pipeline_stages.name: Alert Generation & Deduplication
pipeline_stages.activation_condition: is_fraud_suspected == True (risk_score >= 600 or BLOCK rule triggered)
pipeline_stages.description: Deduplicates alerts over sliding window, creates structured Alert entity with SLA and reason codes.

pipeline_stages.name: Explainability Attribution (SHAP)
pipeline_stages.description: Computes SHAP kernel attributions or heuristic risk factor breakdowns for triage.

pipeline_stages.name: Persistence & Shared Intelligence Dispatch
pipeline_stages.description: Stores alert in tenant database; dispatches anonymized indicator to Redis/PubSub and WebhookService.

pipeline_stages.name: Case Creation & Idempotent Ingestion
pipeline_stages.description: Enforces 24-hour request idempotency via IdempotencyService; scopes case and linked alerts to tenant.

pipeline_stages.name: Evidence Registration & Cryptographic Hashing
pipeline_stages.description: Calculates SHA-256 digest of evidence file, binds evidence ID to case record, updates timeline.

pipeline_stages.name: Analyst Notes & Status Transitions
pipeline_stages.description: Validates state machine transitions, executes optimistic lock check (expected_version/expected_status), updates Merkle timeline hash.

pipeline_stages.name: Four-Eyes Dual Control Signoff
pipeline_stages.description: Verifies primary and secondary supervisor signatures; enforces separation of duties (Approver != Analyst, Approver != Investigator); invalidates stale signatures if dossier changed.

pipeline_stages.name: Terminal Resolution & Regulatory Disposition
pipeline_stages.description: Transitions case to terminal status. Confirmed fraud enables SAR export; false positive permanently disqualifies SAR filing without mutating machine prediction history.

pipeline_stages.name: Audit Logging & Immutable Timeline Hash
pipeline_stages.description: Records append-only investigator actions and verifies cryptographic chain continuity.

pipeline_stages.name: Simulation Configuration & Pipeline Compatibility Validation
pipeline_stages.description: Rejects incompatible configurations upfront (e.g. Additive SecAgg or FHE combined with non-linear Byzantine defenses like Krum/Bulyan/Median).

pipeline_stages.name: Data Ingestion & Non-IID Partitioning
pipeline_stages.description: Loads benchmark dataset (e.g. Elliptic, PaySim) or generates synthetic data, applying Dirichlet partition across consortium bank nodes.

pipeline_stages.name: Local Model Baseline Training
pipeline_stages.description: Trains bank-specific baseline models on local partitions to measure isolated vs federated performance.

pipeline_stages.name: Federated Client Availability & Selection
pipeline_stages.description: Selects participating clients per round; simulates network dropouts and ensures quarantined nodes remain offline.

pipeline_stages.name: Local Training with Privacy Mechanisms
pipeline_stages.description: Applies DP-SGD per-sample gradient clipping, Gaussian noise addition, and Renyi Differential Privacy budget accounting.

pipeline_stages.name: Adversarial Poisoning Injection
pipeline_stages.description: Malicious bank client scales weights or injects backdoor gradients.

pipeline_stages.name: Robust Byzantine Defense
pipeline_stages.description: Applies robust statistical filters (Krum, Bulyan, Coordinate-wise Median, Trimmed Mean, Spectral SVD) to isolate malicious updates.

pipeline_stages.name: Secure Aggregation & Hardware Isolation
pipeline_stages.description: Applies pairwise additive masking, TenSEAL CKKS homomorphic averaging, or Intel SGX enclave attestation.

pipeline_stages.name: Global Parameter Aggregation
pipeline_stages.description: Computes weighted average (FedAvg, FedProx) or custom robust consensus update.

pipeline_stages.name: Global Model Evaluation & Model Registry Promotion
pipeline_stages.description: Evaluates global model metrics (AUC-ROC, F1), records provenance and DP noise profile, and promotes version to 'champion' for live serving.

pipeline_stages.name: Event Ingestion & Schema Parsing
pipeline_stages.description: Extracts canonical transaction fields (sender_id, receiver_id, amount, timestamp, bank_id, transaction_id).

pipeline_stages.name: Canonical Scoped Identity Generation
pipeline_stages.description: Establishes tenant-scoped identity to prevent cross-institution collisions.

pipeline_stages.name: Transport Redelivery & Idempotency Check
pipeline_stages.description: Inspects _seen_transactions registry: if exact re-delivery, suppresses duplicate edge; if contradictory payload, raises ValueError.

pipeline_stages.name: Feature Store Dynamic Window Update
pipeline_stages.description: Checks tx_id idempotency in customer window, appends transaction event, recalculates 1h velocity and 24h rolling average.

pipeline_stages.name: MultiDiGraph Edge Mutation
pipeline_stages.description: Inserts edge into sliding window, updates node degrees and index lookup table; preserves distinct parallel financial edges.

pipeline_stages.name: Downstream Risk Triggering & Broker Offset Commit
pipeline_stages.handler: Inference / Alert Pipeline & Kafka Offset Ack
pipeline_stages.description: Executes downstream scoring if configured and commits message offset only after mutations succeed.
